scripts.translation:
[神工匠]
恭喜。
向勇士们致敬！

scripts.text:
[MasterSmith]
Ah...
The pinnacle
of craftsmanship.
That's the work of
a MasterSmith.
scripts.translation:
[神工匠]
啊...技艺的巅峰。
那便是神工匠的造诣。

scripts.text:
[MasterSmith]
Once you're the
the best of the best,
you begin forging with
the goal of discovering
new and better ways of
crafting...
scripts.translation:
[神工匠]
成为顶尖工匠后，每一次锻造，都是为了探索更新、更好的工艺...

scripts.text:
[MasterSmith]
The time has come!
Our world needs brave,
hard-working adventurers
like you...
scripts.translation:
[神工匠]
时机已到！
这个世界需要你这样勇敢、勤勉的冒险者...

scripts.text:
[MasterSmith]
Would you like to
become a MasterSmith?
scripts.translation:
[神工匠]
你想成为神工匠吗？

scripts.text:
[MasterSmith]
When you're ready,
feel free to come back.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[神工匠]
准备好了，随时回来吧。
向勇士们致敬！

scripts.text:
[MasterSmith]
It is still possible for you to learn more skills. Please use
all of your remaining Skill Points before returning to me.
scripts.translation:
[神工匠]
你还有可以学习的技能。
请用完剩余的技能点，再来找我。

scripts.text:
[MasterSmith]
Congratulations!
As a MasterSmith,
I hope you will forge
a path towards a brighter
future for Midgard.
scripts.translation:
[神工匠]
恭喜！
愿你身为神工匠，为米德加尔特开辟通往光明未来的道路。

scripts.text:
[MasterSmith]
Welcome
to Valhalla,
the Hall of Honor.
scripts.translation:
[神工匠]
欢迎来到荣耀之厅——英灵殿。

scripts.text:
[MasterSmith]
Please make
yourself comfortable
while you are here.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[神工匠]
在这里安心休息吧。
向勇士们致敬！
